MC-1.title: Pre-Vote round started while Candidate survives leader establishment and makes the new leader re-elect
MC-1.cause: establish_leader/become_leader do not reset Engine.pre_candidate, and handle_pre_vote_resp calls elect() on a Pre-Vote quorum without checking that the node is still the non-leader whose vote the round probed; a Candidate can start such a r

MC-2.title: Stale Pre-Vote grant from a node outside the current round's voter set panics RaftCore
MC-2.cause: Pre-Vote responses are correlated only by the pre-candidate leader id, which every round started from the same local vote shares, while each round freezes its own voter set; handle_pre_vote_resp passes any matching grant to Candidate::grant
